items.claim: Foxconn 與 Stellantis 合資公司採 50-50 表決權，雙方各投入最佳 IP
items.quote: The JV will be a 50-50 voting rights company
items.speaker: Yves Bonnefont

items.claim: Foxconn 及其子公司 FIH 先與 Stellantis 合作開發資訊娛樂軟硬體
items.quote: Foxconn and our subsidiary company, FIH, will initially work
items.speaker: Yang-Wei Liu

items.claim: Tavares 表示本合資是長期策略計畫的一塊，完整計畫年底發表
items.quote: we will present to you by the end of this year.
items.speaker: Carlos Tavares

items.claim: Mobile Drive 不獨家供應 Stellantis，也將供應其他公司
items.quote: Mobile Drive will not be exclusive to Stellantis.
items.speaker: Yang-Wei Liu

items.claim: 合資公司須與其他供應商以公平交易條件競爭 Stellantis 的業務
items.quote: It also has to compete for Stellantis' business
items.speaker: Yves Bonnefont

items.claim: 合資公司承接約 250 名已組好的軟體工程師
items.quote: software engineers preassembled, organized.
items.speaker: Yves Bonnefont

items.claim: Stellantis 稱全球有 1,200 萬輛活躍連網車
items.quote: Today, Stellantis has 12 million active connected vehicles
items.speaker: Yves Bonnefont

items.claim: 軟體策略目標之一：打造持續更新的車與服務
items.quote: we want this strategy to create forever up-to-date vehicle
items.speaker: Yves Bonnefont

items.claim: 永遠最新策略伴隨新商業模式與變現方式
items.quote: a new business model, a new monetization approach
items.speaker: Yves Bonnefont

items.claim: 被問收入分成時，稱分成方式依地區而定，JV 角色為技術提供者
items.quote: the way we will work on the revenue will also depend
items.speaker: Yves Bonnefont

items.claim: Calvin 稱執行重點為速度、品質與具競爭力成本
items.quote: execute with speed, quality and competitive cost.
items.speaker: Calvin Chih

items.claim: Calvin 稱個人化與區域服務是無縫體驗與經常性收入的關鍵
items.quote: experience and the recurring revenue generation.
items.speaker: Calvin Chih

items.claim: Stellantis 車款價格帶涵蓋 1.5 萬至 15 萬歐元，座艙需可擴充
items.quote: vehicles ranging from EUR 15,000, up to EUR 150,000.
items.speaker: Yves Bonnefont

items.claim: JV 技術預計服務 Stellantis 全產品組合而非單一品牌
items.quote: serve the full portfolio of Stellantis and not specifically

items.claim: JV 將開發應用層與部分座艙中介層
items.quote: layer as well as some of the cockpit middleware.
items.speaker: Yves Bonnefont

items.claim: JV 初期聚焦座艙與連網服務
items.quote: the JV is in the first stage extremely focused on cockpit
items.speaker: Yves Bonnefont

items.claim: Calvin 區分 Mobile Drive 與 MIH：前者逐車開發，非平台概念
items.quote: It's not a platform concept.
items.speaker: Calvin Chih

items.claim: Calvin 回應 Tesla／VW 自研：多數現行車款使用多供應商，整合耗時
items.quote: cars selling today are using multiple suppliers.
items.speaker: Calvin Chih

items.claim: 工程師執行主要在亞洲（台北），歐洲設需求與專案管理據點
items.quote: execution, the engineer in Asia, particularly in Taipei.

items.quote: prevent people who prefer projected mode from using

items.quote: Cybersecurity will also be our primary focus.
items.speaker: Calvin Chih

items.quote: We believe that this disruption is a must for Stellantis.

items.claim: Mobile Drive 無市占目標，稱剛成立
items.quote: No, we don't have that yet.
